vibe_rationale: Curated experimental music, art and discourse festival grown from the warehouse rave scene, close to SURPLUS in spirit but niche and institution-partnered.
fit_notes: Adult, 18-plus club and arts audience where the discourse and art strands suit a talk or care-space partnership rather than billboards. Twelve partners and institutional collaborators are listed with a general contact page, so the route is invitation-led, and no 2027 edition is yet announced.
